title: Vedanā (I--IV)
text: 1. Sāvatthi || || [2--33] Tisso ima vedanā || katamā tisso || || Sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā || imā kho bhikkhave tisso vedanā || || Imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave tissannaṃ vedanānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya || la || ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || ||
